paper.note: COMPOUNDING: each new position = 5% of current balance (started at $50 on $1,000), 1x. Paper only — no real orders or API keys. 0.05% taker fee per side, fill at the confirmation candle close. One open position per coin, traded only on the active timeframe (5m). TP +$2 net (after fees) or an opposite signal, whichever first. A take-profit just closes the trade (no flip). Positions are not closed on fade, timeout, or stop.

paper_unconfirmed.note: COMPOUNDING: each new position = 5% of current balance (started at $50 on $1,000), 1x; DCA legs match the first leg. Paper only — no real orders or API keys. 0.05% taker fee per side. Enters at the close of the candle when a new unconfirmed BUY?/SELL? first appears on the active timeframe (5m). One open position per coin. If that signal fades, the position stays open. Every new same-direction unconfirmed signal (including a pivot walk) adds another leg of the first leg's notional, with no fade required. Up to 4 adds (5 legs). An opposite unconfirmed signal closes the whole stack and flips. TP +$2 net (after fees) or an opposite signal, whichever first. A take-profit just closes the stack (no flip). Positions are not closed on fade, timeout, or stop.
